ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the medial lobe surfaces with low-intensity (black) boundaries; estimated 65:35 white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central and outer lobes. High-contrast black mottling concentrated along the leading edges and central column. Two distinct isolated dark circular spots: one in the upper-mid region of the left lobe white field, and one in the upper-mid region of the right lobe white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle of approximately 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a tapering curve from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular white/grey protrusions localized at the extreme distal tips (points) of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark disrupting the white field on the left lobe; one shorter horizontal linear disruption in the mid-right lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake mark on left lobe; dense barnacle colonization on distal tips; secondary circular scarring/pigmentation spots on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical placement of focal dark spots on the distal white fields of both lobes.
